title: Egyptian journalist's retrial adjourned as UN warns of 'assaults on press freedom'
summary_full: Mada Masr editor-in-chief Lina Attalah is being tried on the charge of "publishing false news" and potentially faces imprisonment.
summary_public: Mada Masr editor-in-chief Lina Attalah is being tried on the charge of "publishing false news" and potentially faces imprisonment.
